question: What division of eight octads is sought to be known fully and endlessly?
premises: There exists a division into eight octads
The speaker desires to know this division fully
The knowing is described as endless or thorough
inference: The speaker seeks complete and thorough knowledge of the division of the eight octads
uncertainties: anantathā may mean endlessly or in infinite detail
plain_english: I wish to know fully and endlessly the division of the eight octads.
